visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of a woman in a black bucket hat, white t-shirt, and fishing vest squatting on a concrete pier next to a pond. She holds a thin, black fishing rod that is significantly bowed toward the water, indicating tension. The background consists of a large, green-tinted pond surrounded by lush green grass, trees, and several other people fishing in the distance under a bright, cloudy sky. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of the woman as she holds up a fishing hook with a large, crumbly brown bait attached. She points at the bait with her right hand while explaining something, her expression focused and professional. A man in a grey t-shirt stands directly behind her, playfully making peace signs with his hands. (3) The camera follows her hands as she carefully lowers the baited hook into the shallow water at the edge of the pier. She watches the bait intensely, and small ripples spread from the point of entry. Yellow and white text overlays appear at the bottom. (4) Suddenly, she lifts the rod, and a fish splashes at the surface. She uses a red-rimmed landing net to scoop a silver-colored fish out of the water. She laughs heartily, her eyes squinting in delight, while the man behind her looks on. (5) She holds the caught fish, still in the net, and then picks it up to show the camera. She has a wide, triumphant smile. (6) The video transitions to a graphic outro featuring a circular portrait of the woman in a pink top, surrounded by a floral wreath against a black background, with social media icons and 'Like, Subscribe, Share' prompts.
